description: A Java class 'ImageResizer' that extends 'ImageWorker' to resize images from resources or files to specified dimensions, with methods for decoding and sampling down bitmaps efficiently.

classes.name: ImageResizer
classes.description: A subclass of ImageWorker that resizes images from resources or files to target dimensions, optimizing memory usage.

methods.name: ImageResizer
methods.description: Constructor initializing with specific width and height or a single size for both dimensions.

methods.name: setImageSize
methods.description: Sets target image dimensions, either separately or as a square.

methods.name: processBitmap
methods.description: Processes a resource ID into a downsampled bitmap in background.

methods.name: decodeSampledBitmapFromResource
methods.description: Decodes and samples down a bitmap from resources to specified dimensions, utilizing inBitmap if available.

methods.name: decodeSampledBitmapFromFile
methods.description: Decodes and samples down a bitmap from a file path.

methods.name: decodeSampledBitmapFromDescriptor
methods.description: Decodes and samples down a bitmap from a file descriptor.

methods.name: calculateInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates optimal inSampleSize for bitmap decoding to match requested dimensions.

methods.name: addInBitmapOptions
methods.description: Adds inBitmap options for efficient bitmap reuse on Honeycomb or newer.
